answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can issue capability tickets only for verifiable useful work — a completed training step or a solved task with a checkable result — so each identity must prove real effort before acting. Willow seeds drift everywhere, but only the ones landing in real soil grow; random peer audits likewise spot-check tickets, and any identity caught with fake work loses its tickets and its stake. An attacker can plant a knoll of fake accounts, but each ticket costs provable work and audits strike at random, so running a canyon-sized fake army costs more than it earns.
